_about: Every mod's protocol-plane permissions (appServer.*), each with the graph gap that requires it and the part that closes it, or why the mod is low-level by intent (docs/design/graph-integrity.md G8.1). scripts/protocol-plane.mjs prints the report; tests/protocol-plane.test.mjs keeps this file and the manifests in step.

appServer.clients.gap: the account's rate limits read by the provider, as facts on CodexUsage at the source's fidelity (G1.2)

appServer.clients.lowLevel: checks the protocol plane's client leases in the QA copy

appServer.observe.lowLevel: records every frame of the protocol for QA
the lifecycle integration test's fixture (tests/integration/slice-lifecycle.test.mjs): counts thread/started on the protocol plane; the SDK's starters lead with the graph (G8.3)
